description: Modules sonores passages piétons is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Modules sonores équipant la signalisation lumineuse tricolore pour les personnes aveugles ou malvoyantes. Extraction de la Base EVESA Gestionnaire de l’éclairage public et de la Signalisation Lumineuse Tricolore de la Ville de Paris. Ce jeu de données peut être lié au jeu de données Signalisation Tricolore Lumineuse. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are modules sonores, SLT, sonorisation, feux tricolores, handicap, passages piétons. The portal shows 10,431 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
